visual_action: A slideshow of still photos featuring Minnesota Governor Tim Walz. The photos depict Walz on stage at a political rally with Kamala Harris, with his family while holding a document, at a bill signing ceremony, interacting with children on a football field, speaking with a woman holding a baby, and talking with two men outdoors in a rural setting.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: He is the subject of every photo and is named in on-screen text throughout the video, such as 'Governor Tim Walz'.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Appears on stage next to Tim Walz in the first and last photos of the slideshow.

cast.name: Pete Buttigieg

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video is titled 'Democratic Leaders' and features quotes from numerous prominent Democrats, posted by the @democrats account.

on_screen_text.text: "Tim Walz is an exceptionally effective governor and also great to work with."
"Governor Walz believes that government works to serve us. Not just some of us, but all of us."
"He is a former public school teacher, football coach, and strong union supporter."
"Walz has a strong track record of putting government on the side of working families."
"Tim Walz is wonderful. He's a Heartland of America Democrat."
"He'll be an incredible partner to our first woman president."

spoken_summary: There is no speech or dialogue in the video; it is set entirely to music.
audio_music: An upbeat, joyful electronic track plays consistently throughout the video, creating a positive and energetic tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow of still photos. Each photo with a text overlay stays on screen for approximately 3-4 seconds before transitioning to the next.
central_claim: Tim Walz is an effective and well-respected leader endorsed by a wide ideological spectrum of prominent figures within the Democratic Party.
intended_effect: To generate positive sentiment and build support for Tim Walz by showcasing his broad party endorsements and presenting him as a competent and relatable figure.
